subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should /plugins/publish ship an automatic README-based package changelog preview, or should package release changelogs remain manual-only for now?
rationale: Current main is manual-only, while this contributor PR adds a new user-facing OpenAI-backed public action; that product direction should be explicit before merge even after the mechanical finding and proof gap are resolved.

options.title: Ship auto-preview after fixes
options.body: Accept the auto-preview direction once the package prompt wording is fixed and real publish-flow proof is added.

options.title: Keep changelog manual-only
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep package release notes as explicit publisher-authored text until maintainers choose a different UX.

recommendation.title: Ship auto-preview after fixes
recommendation.body: Accept the auto-preview direction once the package prompt wording is fixed and real publish-flow proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest current-history owner for the package publish route, package backend, and changelog helper touched by this direction.
